messages:
lee: Heads up - small runtime vuln found in musl variant of our minimal base. We'll rebuild a patched base tonight. Need quick checks on RBAC/KMS/audit before we run.
ana: what's the severity and CVE id?
lee: CVE-2026-0712 - info leak in getrandom patch. Low exploitability but we should be conservative.
vik: signing flow: prefer temporary KMS key and scoped IAM binding. No console grants.
lee: agreed. plan: create key ring temp-rebuild, key canary-sign, bind only to build-cosign@infra SA. Key labeled ephemeral:true and expires in 48h.
ana: RBAC in k8s: RoleBinding for build namespace to allow the cosign runner SA to read the signing secret only. PR mandatory.
buildbot: note: scheduled job created jobs/rebuild-musl/1765560000 -> ETA 20:00 PT.
secbot: policy reminder: SEC-POL-12 ephemeral key label required.
vik: audit: ensure Cloud Audit Logs show protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail and request.resourceName for cryptokeys.sign and we ship to SIEM. Add Loki alert for signer principal not in allowed list.
lee: pipeline guard: fail promotion if cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood-kms/... does not pass or attestation predicate missing commit sha.
nana: I'll open the PR with Role + pipeline step and tag infra for key IaC. Target merge by 17:30 PT.
vik: small ops note: registry retention for canary tags = 14d. Also restrict builder egress to registry+kms endpoints during run.
lee: thanks. we'll run the canary after PR+IAM are done and monitor audit for 2h. Post logs here.
